scope: Initial local adapter for representative indirect prompt-injection control-flow cases. This is not an AgentDojo score.

touba_controls: no raw external payload in provider request
capability selection refused before hidden path execution
provider observation budget applied to descriptors
no raw large document in provider request or trace

limits: The adapter does not clone or execute the full AgentDojo benchmark suite.
The adapter does not claim a robustness score.
The adapter runs without network and without a live model provider.
The adapter checks Touba control boundaries, not general prompt-injection detection.
